title: @ycforge/pilot outputs — .ycsf/outputs.yaml schema and OUT_* error code catalog
description: Machine-readable contract for Project C user outputs (spec 016): JSON Schema for the .ycsf/outputs.yaml file (requiring version: 1 and the outputs mapping), the shape of OutputsDiagnostic and BuildOutputs result, and the catalog of OUT_* load/validation error codes. User output values are 3-segment IDL references domain.name.property (ResourceReference grammar, contract 002), resolved to ${terraform_type.name.property} via the C-owned reverse side-table DOMAIN_TO_TF_TYPE derived from IDL_DOMAIN_BY_TF_TYPE (spec 015); the merged deterministic file is 99-ycsf-outputs.tf.json (IDEA §26, supersedes 00- from spec 014).

outputsYaml.title: .ycsf/outputs.yaml entry
outputsYaml.description: Formatted contract (Constitution III): version: 1 and the outputs mapping. Exactly two top-level keys are allowed; any other key is rejected (OUT_INVALID, Constitution V — fail-fast over silent ignore). Output names must match [a-z][a-z0-9_]* and must NOT start with the reserved ycsf_ prefix (OUT_RESERVED_PREFIX).

version.description: Required. Format version (Constitution III); anything else or absent → OUT_VERSION.

outputs.description: Mapping of output name → rule. Each rule references a generated resource via a 3-segment IDL. Duplicate YAML keys are rejected at the parse gate (uniqueKeys); duplicate output names across layers (user+auto) → OUT_DUPLICATE_NAME at buildOutputs.

userOutput.title: One user-declared output
userOutput.description: value — 3-segment IDL reference domain.name.property (each segment [a-z][a-z0-9_]* per contract-002 ResourceReference grammar). A grammatically valid but non-existent domain/name yields OUT_UNRESOLVED_IDL at resolution (conservative toward additive side-table growth, spec 019). Property is NOT validated against provider schema (Constitution IV). ${...} in value is an error (user passes the bare IDL; buildOutputs wraps it).

description.description: Optional output description; when absent → omitted from the generated file (undefined omits, empty string '' is preserved).

outputsDiagnostic.title: Outputs load/build diagnostic
outputsDiagnostic.description: Emitted by loadOutputs (structural OUT_VERSION/OUT_INVALID with file/line/column populated) or by the pure buildOutputs validation phase (OUT_RESERVED_PREFIX / OUT_INVALID_VALUE / OUT_UNRESOLVED_IDL / OUT_DUPLICATE_NAME / OUT_INVALID_AUTO_PREFIX; location fields stay undefined since the transform has no file knowledge).

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic with context (for OUT_UNRESOLVED_IDL: the reference and the alphabetically ordered available IDL list).

name.description: Optional: offending output name (OUT_RESERVED_PREFIX, OUT_DUPLICATE_NAME, OUT_INVALID_VALUE, OUT_UNRESOLVED_IDL, OUT_INVALID_AUTO_PREFIX).

file.description: Optional: only populated by the loader for structural OutputsDiagnostic-compatible diagnostics.

field.description: Optional: unset unless a specific field is at fault.

line.description: Optional: 1-based line from the YAML parse gate.

column.description: Optional: column from the YAML parse gate.

availableIdls.description: Alphabetically ordered list of IDLs addressable in the generated model (OUT_UNRESOLVED_IDL only).

errorCodes.title: OUT_* error code catalog
errorCodes.description: All outputs load/validation error codes (spec 016). Distinct OUT_* family, separate from PML_* (project-model), BRG_* (plugin-registry), MTL_* (materializer-dispatch) and EXT_* (extensions) codes. Compared via constants in src/contracts/outputs.ts, never string literals (Constitution V). MTL_OUTPUT_NAME_COLLISION (spec 014) stays for dispatch-level duplicates; OUT_DUPLICATE_NAME is the merge-level (user+auto) point.

OUT_MISSING_FILE.description: .ycsf/outputs.yaml is absent when loadOutputs is called (FR-002). Throws, never a validation result — symmetric with EXT_MISSING_FILE (015), BRG_MISSING_FILE (013) and spec 011 loadProjectModel. File presence is decided by orchestrator 021.

OUT_VERSION.description: version key absent or not equal to 1 (FR-003, Constitution III).

OUT_INVALID.description: Structural invalidity (FR-004): YAML syntax errors / duplicate YAML keys (parse gate uniqueKeys) / unknown top-level keys / outputs missing or not a mapping / rule not a mapping / value not a string / description not a string or absent / output name violating [a-z][a-z0-9_]*. Collected for ALL errors (collect-all).

OUT_RESERVED_PREFIX.description: User output name starts with the reserved ycsf_ prefix (IDEA §26: prefix is reserved for auto-generated outputs). Fail-fast (Constitution V): error, never silent rename.

OUT_INVALID_VALUE.description: value is not a valid 3-segment IDL reference per ResourceReference grammar (contract 002), or already contains ${...} (the user passes a bare IDL; buildOutputs wraps it).

OUT_UNRESOLVED_IDL.description: IDL reference (domain.name.property) cannot be resolved: domain not in DOMAIN_TO_TF_TYPE or domain.name not in the IDL index built from the generated resources (FR-007). Message carries the reference and the alphabetically ordered list of available IDLs. Resolution errors collected for ALL outputs before any file is generated (all-or-nothing).

OUT_DUPLICATE_NAME.description: Output name appears more than once in the merged file (user-user, user-auto, auto-auto; FR-005/FR-016). Collect-all; all-or-nothing. Precedent for the merge-level point: MTL_OUTPUT_NAME_COLLISION covers only dispatch-level duplicates within a single materializer graph.

OUT_INVALID_AUTO_PREFIX.description: Auto-generated output name does NOT start with ycsf_ (materializer contract violation; FR-017). Fail-fast (Constitution V): error, never silent prefix insertion.
